newsitem.title: DUBAI: Gulf states to impose ban on shrimp fishing.
newsitem.headline: Gulf states to impose ban on shrimp fishing.

text.p: Gulf Arab agriculture ministers have decided to ban shrimp fishing in their waters for six months every year, a Saudi newspaper reported on Monday.

The Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) secretariat, in a statement to the daily Saudi Gazette, said the ban, apparently aimed at avoiding the depletion of shrimp stocks, will be imposed anytime between January and September.
The GCC -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Bahrain and Oman -- is an economic and political alliance.
